name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
description: The gate command ran once in the project repository with the cut tree, candidate copy and initially empty evidence directory; the candidate digest matched install and its launch marker was absent. The recorded pass carried 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3 and ledger answered as itself.
